claims.text: Hyperuricosuria: ↓animal protein; if diet can't Δ, allopurinol.
claims.quote: In hyperuricosuria, intake of animal protein should be reduced. If the diet cannot be changed, allopurinol lowers uric acid production

claims.text: Uric acid stones: raise urine pH to 6-6.5 w an oral K-containing alkalinizer (eg, potassium citrate) + fluids.
claims.quote: For uric acid calculi, the urine pH must be increased to between 6 and 6.5 by giving an oral alkalinizing medication that contains potassium (eg, potassium citrate) along with increased fluid intake

claims.text: Recurr calcium stones: thiazide, potassium citrate or allopurinol.
claims.quote: Thiazide diuretics, potassium citrate, or allopurinol should be prescribed after recurrence of calcium stones
persistent vomiting can be treated with an antiemetic (eg, ondansetron)
